# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP. This is a breaking release that rolls up all v4 preview work: the Skia engine jumps from m132 to m148, variable font and color font palette support land, animated WebP encoding is added, and the singleton/handle lifecycle is fundamentally reworked. Review the breaking changes section before upgrading from 3.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface — text measures as zero** — Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs), so MeasureText/DrawText return nothing. Migration: pass an explicit typeface, e.g. new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect 'unset' with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of null. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default, not null** — The underlying font moved from a null/lazy default to an explicit SKTypeface.Default. Text still renders, but paint.Typeface == null checks no longer fire. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty or drop the null check. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName for a missing family now returns Default on all platforms** — Android used to return null for an unknown family; now all platforms return SKTypeface.Default for consistency. For a strict null-on-miss, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) which still returns null when no match is found. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws on out-of-range offsets** — The native offset is 32-bit; the long overload was silently truncating. It is now [Obsolete] and does a checked cast — large offsets throw OverflowException. Migrate to Move(int), clamping or validating the value yourself. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **SKPaint legacy text/font members are now compile errors** — Members obsoleted in v3 (e.g. TextSize, Typeface on SKPaint) were promoted to compile errors. Move typeface and text-size configuration onto SKFont. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed** — The protected setter was part of the old lifecycle API and has been removed. Subclasses that wrote to it must stop; the property is now read-only. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo type changed; GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo was retyped from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. The old struct lost IEquatable, == and != operators. Update type references and equality checks.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed (fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, fOwnsInstanceAndDevice)** — These interop fields were dropped upstream. Use fVkExtensions in place of fExtensions, and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures. The ownership and version-redundancy fields have no replacement — simply remove those assignments.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process (not returns null) on Vulkan 1.0** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a Vulkan 1.0 instance or leaving GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion at its default 0 triggers SK_ABORT — a fatal abort, not an exception. Set apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both VkApplicationInfo and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion. Genuinely 1.0-only hardware must use a different backend. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))

## Engine

- **Skia updated from m132 to m148** — The bundled engine covers milestones m132 through m148, including several rounds of upstream chrome/m147 and m148 bug-fix merges. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — Variable font axes can now be set on SKTypeface, and color font palettes are fully supported via new palette APIs. HarfBuzzSharp gains matching variable-axis access. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding (SKWebpEncoder)** — SKWebpEncoder now supports encoding multi-frame animated WebP images, covering a frequently requested feature gap. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion** — A new GetData() method on SKStream returns the stream's underlying data without copying, enabling efficient pipelines that pass stream content to other APIs. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKCanvas.DrawSurface and SKSurface.Draw gain SKSamplingOptions** — Both draw methods now accept SKSamplingOptions for control over filtering quality when blitting a surface onto a canvas. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HarfBuzzSharp: HBColor struct and missing API wrappers** — A new HBColor struct correctly maps hb_color_t. Several missing API wrappers were added and naming-convention violations corrected. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Linux Bionic (Android NDK libc) native asset support** — Native assets for Linux Bionic are now built and shipped, enabling SkiaSharp in environments that use the Android NDK C runtime on Linux. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support** — The Tizen platform now builds native assets for both x64 and arm64. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset fixes** — GetPixelSpan was using Height instead of Width to compute the x-axis offset, and the wrong stride for row indexing. Both are now correct. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first** — A race between the SKPath and SKPathBuilder finalizers could crash the process. The finalizer ordering is now safe. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default typeface resolution moved to managed layer** — Default-typeface resolution no longer calls into native on Android API 36+, fixing crashes when the system font manager returns null. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9** — SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI consumers on .NET 9 could hit a DLL-not-found error for the WinUI projection assembly; this is now resolved. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **SKGLView stops rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switch on Android** — An Android MAUI TabBar switch caused the GLView to lose its render surface. The view now correctly re-initializes after regaining focus. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — The way SkiaSharp manages singleton and shared native instances has been fundamentally redesigned to prevent double-dispose, use-after-free, and premature finalization bugs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native-compat gate moved from ModuleInitializer to SkiaApi constructor** — The native binary compatibility check now runs in the SkiaApi static constructor rather than a module initializer, improving reliability and error messaging at startup. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Apple platform TFMs corrected: 26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps** — SkiaSharp libraries now target platform version 26.0 on Apple platforms, while app-facing packages use unversioned TFMs, matching the recommended pattern for library authors. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WASM: pre-.NET 8 Emscripten native builds dropped** — Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions before the .NET 8 era are no longer produced, reducing artifact size. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **expat updated to 2.8.1** — The bundled libexpat has been updated to 2.8.1 for security and stability. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))
- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.2.0, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, libpng to 1.6.58, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libexpat to 2.7.5** — All bundled native dependencies have been refreshed to current stable versions. ([#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 adds a proper HBColor struct for hb_color_t, fills in several missing API wrappers, corrects naming-convention violations, and updates the underlying harfbuzz native library to 14.2.0.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 stabilized the 4.148.0 API surface: SKPixmap GetPixelSpan fixes, pre-v4 obsolete promotions to error, and the final round of m147/m148 upstream merges.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Preview 3 landed HarfBuzz 14.2.0, libjpeg-turbo and zlib bumps, HBColor and missing HarfBuzz wrappers, the WASM Emscripten simplification, and a large CI and build-system modernization.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

## Preview 2 (May 6, 2026)

Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), the SKPath finalizer fix, Apple TFM corrections, and further CI hardening.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.1.1...v4.147.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m132–m147 engine jump, variable fonts, color palettes, SKCanvas.DrawSurface sampling options, Linux Bionic support, Tizen multi-arch builds, and the SKPaint/SKFont API migration.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v3.119.4...v4.147.0-preview.1.1)
